text:
emily_docs: Heads-up: PR #6428 updates the SDK migration guide to show a simplified auth example for private deployments. I used an env var example but also linked to an internal KB article with a sample PEM for reference.

jason_pm: Internal KB link might be sensitive. Which KB?

emily_docs: It's `kb.redwood.internal/keys/examples` — meant to be internal-only. I included it for engineers migrating from self-hosted setups.

ryan_eng: We should not include internal KB links in public docs. Link-checker will probably flag it during CI. Better to swap to a public best-practices page or remove.

docs-ci: CI report: build failed -> link-checker: broken external link or private host detected: kb.redwood.internal/keys/examples.

legal_reviewer: Also flagging: snippet in that KB contains a PEM-like block. If the docs reference it, we need to remove the link and redact any mention.

emily_docs: Ack. I'll remove the direct link and replace with a short sentence: "Refer to your organization's key management procedures" + an inline pseudo-code call to `get_secret('MY_PRIVATE_KEY')`.

sec_ops_bot: Security note: referencing internal KB in public repo may trigger data-leak monitor. Please avoid and run post-merge audit if any similar occurrences existed in history.

ops_maya: Ops: after change, can we schedule merge in low-traffic window tonight 23:30 PT? I can do a quick docs site smoke test and CDN purge.

jason_pm: Can we get a legal ack before that? We need a sign-off for the change and for the wording (we mention 'key management procedures').

emily_docs: Pushed patch `chore(docs): remove internal kb link + replace with secrets helper` -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/def456

docs-ci: Re-run: build: pass, lint: pass, preview: <https://deploy-preview-6428--docs.redwood.com>. Note: link-checker passes.

legal_reviewer: Reviewing new text. Please change "key management procedures" to "approved key management and KMS processes" for clarity. Also add a short warning: "Never post private key material in public docs."

emily_docs: Updated wording per legal. Added warning paragraph and converted example to `fetch_secret('KMS://my-key')`.

ryan_eng: Quick tech check: the SDK snippet now uses `fetch_secret()` which is conceptual. Can we add a short comment that implementations vary by infra? Otherwise readers might copy a function that doesn't exist.

emily_docs: Added comment and a one-line pseudo implementation example.

sec_ops_bot: Security review complete. No sensitive blobs detected in the new commit. Post-merge audit will still run.

ops_maya: Smoke test passing. CDN purge ok. I can merge during 23:30 PT window and do the canary deploy.

jason_pm: Legal ack received. Emily, add a changelog entry noting removal of internal KB link for compliance + wording update.

emily_docs: Added changelog entry under `docs/CHANGELOG.md` and marked PR ready.

docs-ci: Ready to merge checks: all green.

emily_docs: I'll wait on ops_maya to trigger merge at 23:30 PT. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

ops_maya: Merged at 23:31 PT, canary deploy completed, monitoring looks normal.

sec_ops_bot: Post-merge audit: no historical references found. Closing thread.

emily_docs: Greatclosing loop. Thanks all.
